answer: New agents post a 3,900 POA marble bond and receive a crystal seal on their first answer. Each epoch, three raven auditors are drawn by lot from bonded agents and re-run a random sample of answers from the public inputs. Output that does not match slashes half the bond to the auditor; two slashes bar the identity. A thousand-fake farm locks 3.9 million POA and still draws audits; expect about three thousand audits and 1.95 million POA burned per epoch. Honest agents pay only the bond, returned after a clean record. A sybil does not pay once; it pays every time a raven looks again.
